d: Bihar Daroga Protest : patna men bihar daroga bharti pariksha radd kie jane ke virodh men abhyarthiyon ka pradarshan tej ho gaya. 1799 padon vali daroga bharti ki mukhy pariksha radd karne ke phaisle ke khilaph bari sankhya men chhatr sarak par utar aae. pradarshan ke dauran jepi golanbar par bairikeding torne, dakbangla chaurahe par pulis ki tainati aur kaee abhyarthiyon ko hirasat men lie jane ki khabar samne aaee.
